name: Banglish Slug Converter
author: Sirajum Mahdi

sections.description:
Banglish Slug Converter is a WordPress plugin that automatically converts Bengali (Bangla) post and page titles into SEO-friendly “Banglish” (Bengali written in English) slugs. This helps create clean, readable URLs for your Bengali content.

Key Features:

  • Automatic Conversion: Automatically converts Bengali titles to Banglish slugs
  • Avro-based Transliteration: Uses comprehensive Avro keymap for accurate transliteration
  • Custom Mappings: Add your own Bengali-to-English transliteration mappings
  • Complete Coverage: Works with posts, pages, categories, tags, and user nicenames
  • SEO-Friendly: Creates clean URLs that are better for search engines
  • Easy Management: Simple admin interface to manage custom transliterations
  • WordPress Standards: Built following WordPress coding standards and best practices

How it Works:

  1. When you create or edit content with Bengali titles, the plugin automatically generates appropriate slugs
  2. The plugin uses a comprehensive Avro-based transliteration system
  3. You can customize specific transliterations through the settings page
  4. Custom mappings take precedence over default transliterations

Examples:

  • “বাংলা ব্লগ” → “bangla-blog”
  • “নতুন পোস্ট” → “notun-post”
  • “প্রযুক্তি সংবাদ” → “projukti-shongbad”

Development

This plugin is developed following WordPress coding standards. Contributions are welcome on GitHub.

Support

For support questions, please use the WordPress support forums. For bug reports and feature requests, please use the GitHub repository.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/banglish-slug-converter directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings → Banglish Slug Converter screen to configure custom mappings (optional)
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with existing content?

Yes, the plugin works with both new and existing content. When you edit existing posts with Bengali titles, new slugs will be generated automatically.

Can I customize the transliteration?

Absolutely! Go to Settings → Banglish Slug Converter to add custom Bengali-to-English mappings. These custom mappings will take precedence over the default transliterations.

Does this affect my existing URLs?

The plugin only generates new slugs when content is created or edited. Existing URLs remain unchanged unless you manually edit the content.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your existing slugs will remain unchanged. The plugin only affects slug generation, so deactivating it won’t break your existing URLs.

Does this work with custom post types?

Yes, the plugin works with all post types, including custom post types.
